outcome: admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Women with rheumatic diseases (RD) and twin pregnancies (TP)
finding: Twin pregnancy in women with rheumatic diseases was associated with an increased risk of preterm delivery, emergency cesarean section, and admission to the neonatal intensive care unit compared to both singleton pregnancy in women with RD and twin pregnancy in the general obstetric population.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was more frequent in the twin pregnancy group compared to both the singleton pregnancy with RD and the twin pregnancy in the general population (54% vs 15% vs 23%, p = 0.008).
